d:
Watch Jiiva & Thulasi Nair burn the dance floor in ‘Aathangara Orathil’ from Yaan. The super addictive dance number is sung by Gana Bala, but has a classy touch to it. The song get you grooving along to Harris Jayaraj’s fun beats!
Song Name - Aathangara Orathil
Movie - Yaan
Singer - Gana Bala & MC Vickey
Music - Harris Jayaraj
Lyrics - Kabilan
Director - Ravi K. Chandran
Starring - Jiiva, Thulasi Nair
